About Neeraj PattniGrowth Designer

10 years in banking and 7 years as a Designer leading on ground-breaking new products and initiatives in cross-functional teams.

I’ve helped fintechs like ClearScore and Metro Bank build design systems and million-pound acquisition, activation and monetised experiences.

I care deeply about craft and the quality of the products I put into the world. So, whether I’m creating innovative 0 to 1 products or experimenting and iterating relentlessly, the result is thoughtful, beautiful experiences that solve unconscious customer needs, and feel effortlessly delightful.
